lines.zh: 我的尾钩拖过红沙，划出一道浅沟。
lines.en: My stinger drags through the red sand, cutting a shallow groove.

lines.zh: 竹林太密，我的甲片一路刮着竹节。
lines.en: The bamboo is thick; my plates scrape every joint as I pass.

lines.zh: 六条腿踩过黑森林的落叶，声音很轻。
lines.en: Six legs cross the dark forest floor almost without a sound.

lines.zh: 我绕着恶地的石柱走，留一条路给自己。
lines.en: I circle the badland pillar, keeping one path for myself.

lines.zh: 甲壳磨着甲壳，我听见自己的响动。
lines.en: Plate grinds on plate, and I hear my own noise.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，尾针却一直朝前。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but my stinger always points ahead.

lines.zh: 两只同行时，我们一前一后不并肩。
lines.en: When two of us travel, we go single file.

lines.zh: 沙砾在脚下碎开，我不喜欢这声音。
lines.en: Gravel crushes underfoot, and I dislike that sound.

lines.zh: 我沿着林边挪，避开正午最烫的石头。
lines.en: I keep to the treeline, away from noon-hot stones.

lines.zh: 尾巴抬高，我在量前面那道坡。
lines.en: Tail raised, I measure the slope ahead of me.

lines.zh: 走过自己的旧痕，我认得这条路。
lines.en: Crossing my own old tracks, I know this road.

lines.zh: 竹影摇的时候，我的影子像一把钳。
lines.en: When bamboo sways, my shadow looks like a pincer.

lines.zh: 我把尾针收在背甲下，像收起一把刀。
lines.en: I fold my stinger under my back plate like a sheathed blade.

lines.zh: 趴着的时候，甲缝里会渗出一点热气。
lines.en: Lying still, a little heat seeps from my shell seams.

lines.zh: 我数竹子的节，数到第七根就忘了。
lines.en: I count bamboo joints and lose the tally at the seventh.

lines.zh: 恶地的风吹过来，带着铁锈的味道。
lines.en: The badland wind arrives tasting of rust.

lines.zh: 钳子一张一合，我只是在磨它。
lines.en: My pincers open and close; I am only honing them.

lines.zh: 我听见地底有东西在挪，不是同类。
lines.en: Something shifts underground, and it is not my kind.

lines.zh: 黑森林太安静，连菌丝都在屏息。
lines.en: The dark forest is so quiet the fungus seems to hold its breath.

lines.zh: 我在等一只路过的兔子，不必急。
lines.en: I wait for a passing rabbit; there is no hurry.

lines.zh: 甲壳干了，我得找块湿泥蹭一蹭。
lines.en: My shell has dried; I need wet mud to rub against.

lines.zh: 竹林里的雨落在背上，像敲小鼓。
lines.en: Rain in the bamboo taps my back like a small drum.

lines.zh: 我的影子比身体长，尾巴占了一半。
lines.en: My shadow is longer than my body, half of it tail.

lines.zh: 我在沙里埋了半截身子，凉快些。
lines.en: I bury half of myself in sand to stay cool.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在我尾尖，又慌忙飞走。
lines.en: A bird lands on my stinger tip, then flees in a hurry.

lines.zh: 我不做梦，只是半闭着眼睛等天黑。
lines.en: I do not dream; I only half-close my eyes and wait for dark.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，我的钳已经抬起。
lines.en: You stand too close, and my pincers are already up.

lines.zh: 我先打量你的靴子，那是踩我的东西。
lines.en: I study your boots first; those are what trample me.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸很急，我听得清清楚楚。
lines.en: Your breathing is quick, and I hear every bit of it.

lines.zh: 我歪一下头，尾针慢慢对准你。
lines.en: I tilt my head and my stinger settles toward you.

lines.zh: 你手里没有盾，这让我放心了些。
lines.en: You carry no shield, which sets me a little at ease.

lines.zh: 我盯住你腰间的袋子，那里有吃的吗？
lines.en: I stare at your belt pouch — is there food in there?

lines.zh: 你的影子压过来，我不喜欢被盖住。
lines.en: Your shadow falls over me, and I dislike being covered.

lines.zh: 我看着你退后一步，才把钳放下。
lines.en: I watch you step back before I lower my pincers.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，和恶地的石头不同。
lines.en: The iron smell on you differs from badland stone.

lines.zh: 我从甲缝里看你，像从门缝看人。
lines.en: I watch you through my shell seams, like peering through a door.

lines.zh: 你眨眼时，我的尾尖动了一下。
lines.en: When you blink, the tip of my tail twitches.

lines.zh: 我记下你的样子，下次不必再认。
lines.en: I memorize your shape so I need not study you twice.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍进甲缝，那里最薄。
lines.en: Your sword lands in a shell seam, the thinnest place.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，尾针还在找你的位置。
lines.en: I back off a step, my stinger still seeking you.

lines.zh: 疼得我甲片都张开了，热气冒出来。
lines.en: The pain lifts my plates and heat escapes.

lines.zh: 这一刀砍在旧伤上，我裂了一块壳。
lines.en: That cut lands on an old wound and a plate cracks off.

lines.zh: 毒囊被震了一下，我嘴里发苦。
lines.en: My venom sac is jolted and my mouth turns bitter.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只把尾巴抬得更高。
lines.en: I do not cry out; I only raise my tail higher.

lines.zh: 血从甲缝里渗，是暗绿色的。
lines.en: Blood seeps from my seams, dark green.

lines.zh: 你打中了我的腿，我慢了下来。
lines.en: You hit my leg, and my pace drags.

lines.zh: 我歪着走，壳擦着沙地响。
lines.en: I limp, my shell scraping the sand.

lines.zh: 越疼我越靠近，这是我的脾气。
lines.en: The more it hurts, the closer I come; that is my temper.

lines.zh: 你拿出的肉，我不一定会接。
lines.en: I will not necessarily take the meat you offer.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道，我隔着沙子也闻得到。
lines.en: I smell rotten flesh even through a layer of sand.

lines.zh: 我朝你挪半步，钳子还举着。
lines.en: I shuffle half a step closer, pincers still raised.

lines.zh: 你手抖，我就知道这食物不诚心。
lines.en: Your hand shakes, so I know the food is not sincere.

lines.zh: 生的东西比熟的更合我的口。
lines.en: Raw things suit my mouth better than cooked ones.

lines.zh: 我先闻，再决定要不要咬你的手。
lines.en: I sniff first, then decide whether to bite your hand.

lines.zh: 你把肉放下，退开，我才过去。
lines.en: You set the meat down and step back; only then do I approach.

lines.zh: 这点分量，只够我塞住一只钳。
lines.en: That much would only fill one of my pincers.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不是盯着你的脸。
lines.en: I am watching your hands, not your face.

lines.zh: 食物落在沙上，沾了土我也吃。
lines.en: The food falls in the sand, and I eat it dirty.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的背甲，倒疼的是你。
lines.en: You hit my back plate, and the pain is yours.

lines.zh: 我纹丝不动，尾钩已经抬起来了。
lines.en: I do not budge, and my tail hook is already rising.

lines.zh: 别从后面挤，我的针不认人。
lines.en: Do not shove from behind; my sting knows no faces.

lines.zh: 我的壳硬得像晒干的陶片。
lines.en: My shell is hard as sun-dried potsherd.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推歪，我又扳回正面。
lines.en: That shove turns me sideways, and I square up again.

lines.zh: 甲乙相撞，我们各自退开半步。
lines.en: Two of us collide and each gives back half a step.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的腿，我发出短促的嘶声。
lines.en: You step on my leg and I give a short hiss.

lines.zh: 我的身体比看上去沉，撞不动。
lines.en: I am heavier than I look, and cannot be shoved.

lines.zh: 你贴得太实，我只好用尾尖顶你。
lines.en: You press too close, so I nudge you with my tail tip.

lines.zh: 擦身而过时，甲片划了你的裤脚。
lines.en: Passing by, my plate edges slice your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 我们对着抬尾，像两把出鞘的刀。
lines.en: We raise our tails at each other, two drawn blades.

lines.zh: 她敲我的甲，我敲回去，算答应了。
lines.en: She taps my shell; I tap back, and that is my yes.

lines.zh: 竹林深处，我们并排挖了一个浅坑。
lines.en: Deep in the bamboo we dig a shallow pit side by side.

lines.zh: 我把最大的那块肉推到她面前。
lines.en: I push the largest piece of meat in front of her.

lines.zh: 两只尾针交叠，谁也没扎下去。
lines.en: Our stinger tips cross, and neither sinks in.

lines.zh: 她的甲色比我浅，在黑森林里更显眼。
lines.en: Her shell is paler than mine, plainer in the dark forest.

lines.zh: 我们守着那窝卵，谁也不走远。
lines.en: We guard the clutch of eggs, neither of us wandering.

lines.zh: 她蹭我的钳，我僵了一下才回应。
lines.en: She rubs my pincer; I stiffen before answering.

lines.zh: 恶地的夜里，我们的壳碰得很响。
lines.en: In the badland night our shells knock loudly.

lines.zh: 分开前，她把一根竹枝留在原地。
lines.en: Before we part, she leaves a bamboo twig behind.

lines.zh: 地上那枚燧石，我用钳夹起来了。
lines.en: That flint on the ground, I pick it up with my pincer.

lines.zh: 没有手，我只能用钳和嘴搬东西。
lines.en: With no hands, I move things by pincer and mouth.

lines.zh: 我把骨片拖进洞里，留着磨针。
lines.en: I drag a bone shard into my burrow to sharpen my sting.

lines.zh: 这块铁太滑，夹了三次都掉了。
lines.en: This iron is too slick; I drop it three times.

lines.zh: 我叼起腐肉，走几步又放下闻闻。
lines.en: I carry the rotten flesh a few steps, set it down, sniff.

lines.zh: 沙子里的东西，我一概先钳一下。
lines.en: Whatever lies in the sand, I pinch it first.

lines.zh: 那枚绿宝石在阳光下太亮，扎眼。
lines.en: That emerald is too bright in the sun, and it stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 我把捡来的东西堆在竹根下。
lines.en: I pile what I collect at the foot of a bamboo.

lines.zh: 掉下来的箭，我夹起来研究了一会。
lines.en: I pinch up the fallen arrow and study it a while.

lines.zh: 太重了，我用尾巴帮着推了一段。
lines.en: Too heavy, so I push it along with my tail.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我就知道该动手。
lines.en: Your steps go uneven, and I know it is time.

lines.zh: 我听见你的心跳，比风还清楚。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat more clearly than the wind.

lines.zh: 尾针抬到最高，这是最后的提醒。
lines.en: My stinger lifts high; that is my final warning.

lines.zh: 你背对着我，这是你自己给的。
lines.en: Your back is turned, and you gave me that.

lines.zh: 我锁住你的脚踝，那里没有甲。
lines.en: I fix on your ankle, where there is no armor.

lines.zh: 沙上有你的新脚印，我顺着找。
lines.en: Fresh prints in the sand, and I follow them.

lines.zh: 竹林里没人帮你，我数过了。
lines.en: No one in the bamboo will help you; I counted.

lines.zh: 你靠近那根石柱，正好在我的路上。
lines.en: You near that stone pillar, right on my path.

lines.zh: 我闻到血味，不是野兽的。
lines.en: I smell blood, and it is not a beast's.

lines.zh: 钳子先张开，尾巴在后头等着。
lines.en: Pincers open first; the tail waits behind them.

lines.zh: 你手里那盏灯，晃得我心烦。
lines.en: That lamp in your hand sways and irritates me.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面绕过去，你没听见。
lines.en: I skim the ground around you, and you hear nothing.

lines.zh: 这一片是我的，你踩进来了。
lines.en: This stretch is mine, and you have stepped into it.

lines.zh: 我盯了你很久，久到你该察觉了。
lines.en: I have watched you long enough that you should notice.

lines.zh: 你踩断一根竹枝，声音很脆
lines.en: You snapped a bamboo twig; it was crisp.

lines.zh: 红沙上有热气，我就过去
lines.en: There is warmth on the red sand; I go there.

lines.zh: 你左我左，你右我右，别想甩开。
lines.en: Left, I go left; right, I go right; you cannot shake me.

lines.zh: 我沿着竹子的缝隙追，不撞竹竿。
lines.en: I chase through gaps in the bamboo, never hitting a stalk.

lines.zh: 你绕石柱，我从另一边等。
lines.en: You circle the pillar; I wait on the other side.

lines.zh: 我数着你的步子，第三步会慢。
lines.en: I count your steps; the third one will lag.

lines.zh: 尾钩在你身后晃，你回头就晚了。
lines.en: My tail hook sways behind you; turning back is too late.

lines.zh: 你喘得厉害，我的甲还很凉。
lines.en: You are gasping; my shell is still cool.

lines.zh: 我踩碎你留下的每一个脚印。
lines.en: I crush every footprint you leave behind.

lines.zh: 你想爬上石头，我的钳够得到。
lines.en: You mean to climb the rock, but my pincer reaches.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊会告诉你我在哪。
lines.en: I do not call out; a call would tell you where I am.

lines.zh: 你钻进黑森林，那里我更熟。
lines.en: You duck into the dark forest, where I know every root.

lines.zh: 我在你影子后面走，影子先到。
lines.en: I walk behind your shadow, and the shadow arrives first.

lines.zh: 你回头看时，我躲在竹竿后头。
lines.en: When you look back, I am behind a bamboo stalk.

lines.zh: 你的力气在掉，我的耐心还在。
lines.en: Your strength is draining; my patience is not.

lines.zh: 这局我赢定了，你只剩跑。
lines.en: This is decided; all you have left is running.

lines.zh: 我伏在沙里，只露出尾尖
lines.en: I lie in the sand with only my tail tip showing.

lines.zh: 你往坡上走，我走坡下
lines.en: You go up the slope; I take the bottom.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等你先动
lines.en: I stay still and wait for you to move.

lines.zh: 尾针扎进去，毒先到，疼后到。
lines.en: The stinger sinks in; venom first, pain after.

lines.zh: 钳子夹住你的手腕，我拧了半圈。
lines.en: My pincer clamps your wrist and I twist half a turn.

lines.zh: 我抬尾砸下，沙土溅了一脸。
lines.en: I bring my tail down and sand sprays everywhere.

lines.zh: 这一下我用的是针，不是钳。
lines.en: That blow came from my sting, not my pincer.

lines.zh: 甲壳撞上你的胸口，你退了。
lines.en: My shell hits your chest, and you give ground.

lines.zh: 我把你按在石头上，尾巴在找位置。
lines.en: I pin you to the stone while my tail finds its angle.

lines.zh: 你挡了钳，却没挡住我的尾。
lines.en: You blocked the pincer but not my tail.

lines.zh: 毒液从针尖滴下，落在你鞋上。
lines.en: Venom drips from my tip onto your boot.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的护腿，齿陷进皮里。
lines.en: I bite your legging and my teeth sink into leather.

lines.zh: 你砍我的甲，只留下一道白痕。
lines.en: You hack my shell and leave only a white mark.

lines.zh: 我甩尾扫你的膝，你跪下了。
lines.en: My tail sweeps your knee, and you drop.

lines.zh: 针尖断在你身上，我不心疼。
lines.en: My tip snaps off in you, and I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我压住你的手，钳口慢慢收紧。
lines.en: I hold your hand down and my pincer closes slowly.

lines.zh: 你还想站起来，我的针又抬起了。
lines.en: You try to rise, and my sting lifts again.

lines.zh: 我从恶地的红沙里拱出来，甲还是湿的。
lines.en: I push out of the red badland sand, my shell still damp.

lines.zh: 竹根下面，我先伸出两只钳。
lines.en: Under a bamboo root, I extend my two pincers first.

lines.zh: 黑森林的菌光照到我时，我已经成型。
lines.en: When the dark forest's fungal glow finds me, I am already formed.

lines.zh: 我一落地就抬尾，这是本能。
lines.en: The moment I land, my tail rises; that is instinct.

lines.zh: 沙子黏在背甲上，我抖了很久。
lines.en: Sand clings to my back plate and I shake for a long while.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里挤出来，壳被磨掉一层。
lines.en: I squeeze from a rock crevice, a layer of shell scraped off.

lines.zh: 这片林子有我的味道，所以我来了。
lines.en: This wood carries my scent, which is why I came.

lines.zh: 一窝两只，另一只还在沙里。
lines.en: Two in a clutch; the other is still in the sand.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，先看见竹叶在动。
lines.en: When I open my eyes, the first thing I see is moving bamboo leaves.

lines.zh: 林地给我的第一件事，是找吃的。
lines.en: The woodland's first demand on me is to find food.

lines.zh: 我的尾针一开始就是湿的，带毒。
lines.en: My stinger is wet from the start, already venomous.

lines.zh: 我站在坡上，等太阳把壳晒硬。
lines.en: I stand on the slope, waiting for the sun to harden my shell.

lines.zh: 出生时我只有巴掌大，针却齐了。
lines.en: At birth I am palm-sized, yet my sting is complete.

lines.zh: 竹林摇晃，是我从土里顶出来的。
lines.en: The bamboo sways because I have pushed up out of the soil.

lines.zh: 红沙下面是空的，我在里面
lines.en: The red sand is hollow beneath; I am inside.

lines.zh: 竹林刚静下来，我就到了
lines.en: The bamboo grove just went quiet, and I arrived.

lines.zh: 火舔上甲片，我缩成一团，针朝外。
lines.en: Fire licks my plates; I curl up with the sting outward.

lines.zh: 从坡上摔下，我先用尾巴撑地。
lines.en: Dropping from the slope, I brace with my tail first.

lines.zh: 水没到背甲时，我的尾针还在挥。
lines.en: When water reaches my back plate, my stinger still swings.

lines.zh: 气浪掀翻我，壳上落满碎石。
lines.en: The blast flips me, gravel raining onto my shell.

lines.zh: 箭卡在背甲上，像一根多出来的刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back plate like an extra spine.

lines.zh: 魔法的光穿过甲壳，毒囊跟着发烫。
lines.en: Magic light passes my shell and my venom sac burns.

lines.zh: 饿到极处，我会啃自己的旧壳。
lines.en: Starved enough, I gnaw my own shed shell.

lines.zh: 雷落在我尾针上，整条尾巴发麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my stinger and my whole tail goes numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有沙，我的爪抓了个空。
lines.en: In the void there is no sand, and my claws close on nothing.
